name: The Cloud Island Whale
description: A colossal, gentle whale resting on a soft, pastel-colored cloud island, with a tiny, cozy village built on its back, evoking peace and whimsical wonder.
prompt: A colossal, gentle whale made of soft clouds and mist, resting on a giant pastel cloud island, a tiny magical village with glowing lights built on its back, soft pink and blue sunset sky, dreamy atmosphere, whimsical, highly detailed, fantasy illustration, 8k, soft lighting.
caption: A peaceful giant carrying a whole world on its back. 🐋☁️ Where do you think this gentle voyager is heading?
